positions.title: QA Lead
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
-Manage validation projects
-Drive the MindTouch vision in delivering quality content to our customers.
-Mentor and educate QA best practices to all departments.
-Mentor and train QA Engineers into Software Engineers.
-Ensure QA Department remains fully-automated while furthering innovation in QA automation.

positions.title: Sr. QA Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
-Manage QA team in daily routines, planning development projects and meetings to ensure productivity
-Manage and improve automated cloud test infrastructure built on AWS
-Assign customer defects to engineering team based on customers needs and priorities
-Manage features in flight, ensuring automated tests are in place before launch

Achievements:
-Migrate local selenium test infrastructure to Amazon Web Services to produce scalable, parallel performance, utilizing selenium grid and cloud technologies
-Remove customer defect backlog by expanding test coverage to all areas of the product and developing a workflow to maximize performance of an 8 man team, ensuring defects are caught in the QA staging environment
-Remove all manual verification by integrating cross browser and screen shot automated testing

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
-Develop tests using selenium in node.js
-Develop integration tests for product web components written in javascript

positions.title: Thermal Team Lead
positions.description:
-Research and analyze the thermal environment the Triteia cube satellite will be exposed to.
-Provide analysis and input on the material selection and configuration of the components for the Triteia cube satellite.
-Composed a 38 page documented report on the requirements, design, analysis, and risk/hazard analysis for the thermal management of the Triteia cube satellite.
